paragraphs.text: [Mengsong](menghai-county:mengsong-naka) is a township on the eastern side of Menghai County, with Nannuo facing it across the Liusha River. In its north, near Huazhu Liangzi, the highest peak in Xishuangbanna, lies the Lahu village of Naka, where this leaf comes from.

The leaf was made into [ripe pu’er](shou:definition). It was wetted and heaped in a [warm pile](shou:wet-piling) for a month or two, then pressed into a cake. Yunnan has made tea this way since 1973, and the pile is why the cake is ready to drink now instead of after years of keeping.

brewing.text: From a cake, brick or tuo, ease a piece off along the edge with a pick rather than snapping it, so the leaves stay whole. Ripe pu’er takes boiling water and forgives a heavy hand. A common start is about 7 grams to 100 ml, one quick rinse, then short steeps that lengthen as the leaf opens; it gives eight or more good cups.
